name: Citizenship by Registration -- Marriage to a Ugandan Citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Married to a Ugandan citizen for at least 3 years.
requirements.fix_path: Remain married to a Ugandan citizen for 3 years before applying.

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: 3 years married to a Ugandan citizen

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Uganda (Embassy of Uganda, Washington DC) -- Citizenship & Dual Citizenship: citizenship by registration is available to, among others, 'persons married to Ugandan citizens for three years'

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Uganda). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 official diplomatic mission sourced. POSITIVE FINDING, FLAGGED EXPLICITLY: this route is gender-neutral as stated by the source ('persons married to Ugandan citizens'), with no distinction between a foreign husband or foreign wife of a Ugandan citizen -- a contrast to the explicitly gendered marriage-citizenship provisions found elsewhere in this dataset (Qatar, Bahrain, Nigeria). dual_citizenship_allowed is TRUE for this route: Uganda permits dual citizenship generally (see ug_dual_citizenship.json), so a person naturalising via marriage is not required to renounce their prior citizenship, provided their country of origin also permits dual citizenship (a reciprocal requirement -- see ug_dual_citizenship.json for the full mechanics).
